title: `os doctor --verbose` still ends with "Run with --verbose to see fix suggestions."
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

`packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts` (around line 2744) prints the hint "Run with --verbose to see fix suggestions." in the `hasWarnings` branch without checking `flags.verbose`. So a `--verbose` run tells the user to pass the flag they already passed. Confirmed in source at `6091b645`; found beside the clauses of `cli.doctor-deprecation-scan`. Minor.

QA-source: #34859 · cli.doctor-deprecation-scan · observed beside the clauses
